summary: The compliance review of the SwiftLoan product, focusing on App Analytics and Partners, identified several gaps against the reviewed RBI rules. The key findings include: (1) The 'Disbursal' feature does not explicitly confirm that all loan servicing and repayment are executed directly in the RE’s bank account, which could violate DLD2025:9(ii). (2) The privacy policy does not name third parties, violating DLD2025:14(ii). (3) The app accesses mobile phone resources beyond on-boarding/KYC purposes, violating DLD2025:12(i). (4) The feature mentions the names of nodal grievance officers but does not explicitly state that their contact details are prominently displayed, violating DLD2025:11(ii). These findings highlight critical areas requiring immediate remediation to ensure compliance with RBI regulations.
